headline: The Financial Times reports that UK ministers are exploring compulsory reporting on AI safety.
score_reason: Pool 6 lowered by 1: only the headline is available, so the proposal's detail is unverified.
importance_line: What changed: UK ministers are weighing a duty to report on AI safety, which could affect AI developers and, over time, the public who rely on AI systems, but it is only being explored and who would report, what and when are not known.
summary: The Financial Times reports that UK ministers are exploring compulsory AI safety reporting; on 9 Oct 2026 The Times reported, in a story our 10 Oct edition carried, that the UK plans an AI safety law to stop humans losing control of autonomous AI agents.
notes: Headline only: FT page returned 403 and no other outlet carries it. Tracking code removed from the FT link. Continues the Times item of 9 Oct 2026 (our 10 Oct edition, item 85).
